{{Quote|You're a big fella, aren't you?" <br /> "Yes." <br /> "Here for the Cathar settlements?" <br /> "Yes." <br /> "Sure you are. I'll get you a blaster. Ever fired one?" <br /> "Many times." <br /> "Super. On behalf of the Taris Reconstruction Authority, welcome home.|The Cathar settler and a Republic quartermaster|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''settler''' was in the [[Olaris Spaceport]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Olaris]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in the<ref name="TOR" /> [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Dates!">{{TOR_dates|1}} The conversation between the [[Unidentified Republic quartermaster (Taris)|quartermaster]] and the settler is witnessed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] players who visit their faction's version of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Republic classes visit Taris during Act I of their class stories, placing the conversation in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>. He spoke to a [[Unidentified Republic quartermaster (Taris)|human]] [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The quartermaster remarked on the settler's height, which the settler acknowledged, before asking him if he was there for the Cathar settlements. The settler replied in the affirmative, and the human offered him a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] before asking if he'd ever fired one. The Cathar settler said he had, "Many times," and the quartermaster welcomed him to Taris.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The settler first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as an ambient non-player character on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] with the nameplate "Cathar Settler".<ref name="TOR" />
